import pathlib,re,subprocess
rules=[(r'(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}','<your-aws-access-key-id>'),(r'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}','<your-github-token>'),(r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}','<your-huggingface-token>')]
files=[]; replacements={}
for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*'):
 if '.git' in p.parts or not p.is_file():continue
 b=p.read_bytes()
 try:s=b.decode()
 except UnicodeError:continue
 files.append((p,b))
 for pat,placeholder in rules:
  for m in re.finditer(pat,s):replacements[m.group()]=placeholder
 for m in re.finditer(r'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY[\\\"\\x27]?\\]?\\s*=\\s*[\\\"\\x27]?([A-Za-z0-9/+=]{40})(?"'![A-Za-z0-9/+=])'"',s):replacements[m.group(1)]='<your-aws-secret-access-key>'
for p,b in files:
 new=b
 for secret,placeholder in replacements.items():new=new.replace(secret.encode(),placeholder.encode())
 if new"'!=b:
  p.write_bytes(new)
  print('"'SANITIZED',p)
print('UNIQUE CREDENTIAL VALUES',len(replacements))
# Verify exact values are absent from all working files, including binary files.
remaining=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*'):
 if '.git' in p.parts or not p.is_file():continue
 b=p.read_bytes()
 if any(v.encode() in b for v in replacements):remaining.append(str(p))
print('WORKING TREE EXACT-VALUE MATCHES',remaining)
# Scan historical blobs, without displaying secret contents.
objects=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-list','--objects','--all'],text=True).splitlines()
proc=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
found=[]
for entry in objects:
 oid,_,path=entry.partition(' ')
 proc.stdin.write((oid+'\\n').encode());proc.stdin.flush()
 header=proc.stdout.readline().split()
 if len(header)"'!=3:continue
 data=proc.stdout.read(int(header[2]));proc.stdout.read(1)
 if header[1]==b'"'blob' and any(v.encode() in data for v in replacements):found.append(path)
proc.stdin.close();proc.wait()
print('HISTORICAL CONTAMINATED BLOBS',len(found))
print('HISTORICAL PATHS',sorted(set(found)))
